title: Unify Connected-mode Commons branching with VirtualWorld TimelineManager

sections.what: Unify Connected-mode /commons branch listing, forking, and switching onto world.timeline_manager so Viwo and Connected Commons share one branch tree (Vision Principle 4).
sections.why: Connected-mode Commons currently maintains a separate commons.branches tree instead of sharing world.timeline_manager.branches with the scenario.
sections.how: Update commons_state, commons_fork_branch, and commons_switch_branch in routes/commons.py so when not _is_standalone(), branch listing, forking, and switching delegate to world.timeline_manager (using snapshot_for_timeline and restore_from_timeline) while Standalone mode continues using chat.fork_branch / chat.switch_branch.

acceptance.text: In Connected mode (use_viwo_state=true), GET /api/commons/state returns world.timeline_manager active_branch_id and branches
In Connected mode, POST /api/commons/branches and POST /api/commons/branches/switch fork and switch world.timeline_manager directly (restoring world + world.commons together)
In Standalone mode (use_viwo_state=false), Commons keeps its own isolated commons.branches unchanged

custom.browser_ui: When Use Viwo State is enabled in /commons, creating or switching a branch in Commons switches the shared Viwo scenario branch tree and restores both world and chat state together.
